notes: Uses a layered blue-black palette instead of near-black gray throughout the dark popup interface.
Keeps Dynamic, Resource Library, Clipboard, and Agent API surfaces, controls, badges, and content cards coherent in dark mode.
Prevents populated Dynamic and Resource Library cards from clipping, and improves contrast on accent-colored badges and controls.
Lets macOS tint normal, resting, and sleeping menu-bar artwork as native template images while preserving the colored reminder icon.
Keeps Intel macOS and Windows packages marked as beta.
